Stress test and withdrawal rules

Illustration, not advice. Runs your plan through many random markets. Same seed, same numbers.

The stress test needs JavaScript.

What it models

  • Yearly real return = real growth plus a bell-shaped random amount scaled by volatility. No fat tails, so real markets can be worse. Volatility and seed are your own assumptions.
  • No historical return series is included.
  • Tax uses the 2026 tables in the ledger. Not modelled: capital gains tax, provincial credits and surtaxes, OAS recovery from RRSP withdrawals, brackets that rise with inflation.
  • Rules: Bengen 1994 (inflation-adjusted percent); Guyton and Klinger 2006 (guardrails). Fixed percent is this app's own.

Assumptions ledger, tax year 2026

Every figure used, with year and source. Read from canada.ca on 2026-10-30. Verify before relying on it.
